metadata.description: A Claude Code software factory (spec, build, parallel reviews, approval and merge-back with a live dashboard), and a skill finder that picks installed skills by domain and task.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: /factory turns a feature request into a spec, an isolated-worktree build, four parallel reviews, an approval and an unstaged merge-back, with a live dashboard.

plugins.name: skill-finder
plugins.description: Answers "how do I do X" and "find a skill for X" from the skills installed here, checks they can run, asks you to choose, then proceeds.
